name: Hydrated Dollar
oneLiner: HOLLAR is Hydration's overcollateralized dollar stablecoin, minted from DOT, ETH, BTC, and stablecoin collateral on an Aave v3 fork with HSM-anchored peg swaps.
collateral: Overcollateralized by DOT, ETH, vDOT, WBTC, tBTC, USDT, USDC, and giga-token variants (GIGADOT, GIGAETH) on the Hydration appchain; built on Aave v3-forked code
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDP with automated partial liquidations per block; peg stabilized by the HOLLAR Stability Module (HSM), which enables direct stablecoin swaps near $1 and deploys received stablecoins into yield strategies

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Hydration referendum 182 scheduled and executed the HOLLAR launch at Hydration block 9,333,143 on September 22, 2025 for asset 222 and the tracked EVM representation 0x531a654d1696ed52e7275a8cede955e82620f99a. Hydration's product documentation establishes the overcollateralized borrow, liquidation, and HSM design, supporting the CDP archetype.

oracleRisk.summary: HOLLAR uses Hydration's enshrined per-block money-market oracles and automated partial-liquidation engine across its governance-enabled collateral set; public protocol docs do not identify a secondary oracle or a separate bad-debt backstop.

branchApplicability.rationale: HOLLAR can be minted against multiple reserves with asset-specific LTV and liquidation parameters. Hydration documents one common Borrow engine, per-block oracle update path, and automated liquidation mechanism, so those reserves are represented as one grouped collateral branch without inventing reserve-level thresholds.

branches.label: Hydration Borrow HOLLAR collateral reserves
branches.summary: Hydration's common Borrow engine values the governance-enabled HOLLAR collateral set with enshrined per-block oracle updates before evaluating health and liquidation.
collateralAssets: Governance-enabled Hydration Borrow collateral reserves for HOLLAR

feeds.provider: Hydration enshrined money-market oracle with DIA-supported custom feeds
feeds.path: Per-reserve market price -> Hydration runtime oracle update at block start -> Borrow health factor

branches.fallbackBehavior: Hydration documents oracle updates at the beginning of every block but does not identify a secondary price source or a failover mode for unavailable or invalid reserve prices.

collateralParameters.asset: Governance-enabled Hydration Borrow collateral reserves for HOLLAR
collateralParameters.note: Each reserve has its own displayed LTV and liquidation threshold; HOLLAR positions are exposed to liquidation once their aggregate health factor falls below 1.0. No static per-reserve values are asserted here.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Hydration evaluates positions at the beginning of each block and automatically performs partial liquidations to restore health. Its Borrow overview also documents protocol custom flash loans that repay debt, swap seized collateral through the Omnipool, and burn the flash-minted amount.
branches.backstop: The documented liquidation path uses protocol-funded custom flash loans and Omnipool execution rather than requiring liquidator capital; the reviewed docs do not identify a separate reserve or insurance backstop for residual debt.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Hydration's public HOLLAR and Borrow documentation does not specify an oracle-failure shutdown state or how debt remaining after failed liquidation execution is allocated, so no stronger recovery claim is made.

sources.label: DIA Hydration money-market oracle case study

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-07-30 at Hydration EVM block 13389205 via rpc.hydradx.cloud: hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xaa7e0000000000000000000000000000000aa7e0) returns true and delegatedToken() returns the configured 0x0000000000000000000000000000000001000000. The official GhoToken source gates setDelegatedToken behind DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and its ERC20.transferFrom accepts the delegated token's allowance in place of holder approval, so the role holder can point delegatedToken at a contract returning arbitrary allowances and move any individual holder's HOLLAR without holder consent. Hydration OpenGov's root track can additionally replace runtime logic wholesale. Holder-level seizure reach over individual accounts is therefore a live governance-controlled capability, not a hypothetical one.

Borrow markets app URL still live. No public per-asset weight table; envelope remains 100% aggregate borrow-market/HSM collateral with ku=100.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current per-asset collateral weights, the share held via the HOLLAR Stability Module versus borrow positions, and per-asset utilization are not published as a dated aggregate.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-8 (lead rwausdi-multipli)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Collateral is held in on-chain borrow-market and HSM contracts on the Hydration appchain with automated per-block partial liquidations rather than a conventional custodian. Legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, and rehypothecation concepts do not map to this non-custodial structure; operative risks are runtime governance and smart-contract integrity.

mintAuthority.summary: HOLLAR is minted on the Hydration appchain by depositing DOT/ETH/BTC/stablecoin collateral into an Aave v3 (GHO-derived) money market, with the HOLLAR Stability Module anchoring the peg; Hydration governance controls collateral and risk parameters.

controls.label: Hydration Aave-v3 fork money market (minter)
controls.capDescription: HOLLAR mints only against overcollateralized positions on Hydration's Aave-v3-forked (GHO-style) money market, subject to a per-asset supply cap; the launch supply cap was 2,000,000 HOLLAR.
controls.evidence: HOLLAR mints only against overcollateralized positions on Hydration's Aave-v3-forked (GHO-style) money market pallet with a per-asset supply cap (launch cap 2,000,000 HOLLAR); Hydration governance can raise the cap, so the bound is raiseable. The pallet-backed EVM shim at 0x531a654d1696ed52e7275a8cede955e82620f99a has no proxy admin or owner().

controls.label: Hydration governance / parameter admin
controls.capDescription: Hydration governance sets collateral onboarding, risk parameters, supply caps, and the HSM configuration; HOLLAR is governed by Hydration rather than Polkadot OpenGov directly.
controls.evidence: Coverage notes HOLLAR is governed by Hydration (not DOT holders), which controls collateral rules, risk parameters, and the on-chain HOLLAR Stability Module. Hydration's pinned runtime source configures HSM AuthorityOrigin as Root, EconomicParameters, or GeneralAdmin.

controls.label: Hydration OpenGov root track runtime upgrade origin
controls.evidence: Hydration's runtime composes System, ConvictionVoting, Referenda, Origins, Whitelist, and Dispatcher, and its pinned governance configuration defines a `root` referendum track. Runtime code changes are Root-origin operations, so the root OpenGov track is the on-chain governance route that can replace the runtime minting logic. At Hydration block 13133392, state_getRuntimeVersion reported hydradx specVersion 428.

review.evidence: Hydration press and coverage describe HOLLAR as an Aave-v3/GHO-derived overcollateralized stablecoin with the native HSM for peg support, governed by Hydration with parameter-level control over collateral and caps.
review.reviewer: Claude Phase 0c continuation; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-3 (lead usds-sky) (2026-07-20)
review.sourceFreeRationale: Aave-v3/GHO fork mint model and Hydration governance confirmed from coverage and docs. On-chain read via Hydration EVM RPC (https://rpc.nice.hydration.cloud, block 0x14fb62 ≈ 1,375,074) showed HOLLAR at 0x531a654d1696ed52e7275a8cede955e82620f99a is a two-byte pallet-backed EVM shim with no proxy admin slot and no owner(). Hydration's pinned runtime source configures HSM AuthorityOrigin as Root, EconomicParameters, or GeneralAdmin; the runtime composes OpenGov Referenda and a root track. The current Hydration RPC at block 13133392 reported specVersion 428, confirming the runtime-governance path is the relevant mint-logic authority rather than an EVM admin key.
